zh: 标题旁显示版本号，发现新版时提示刷新；更新后展示本次版本内容，关闭后不再重复弹出。
en: Show the current version and a refresh prompt for newer releases; display this release’s changes after updating without repeating dismissed notes.

zh: 缩小桌面条目面板并收紧留白；手机面板采用约半屏高度，支持顶部按钮和向下拖动把手收起。
en: Use a narrower desktop entry panel and tighter spacing; on mobile, use a half-height panel with a collapse button and downward swipe handle.

zh: 改善面板切换、搜索和列表的交互反馈，保留搜索与滚动位置，并支持减少动态效果。
en: Smooth panel, search, and list interactions while preserving search and scroll position and respecting reduced-motion preferences.

zh: 移除时间轴重复年份显示，增加条目圆点空间并收紧内部留白，改善年份跳转和键盘浏览反馈。
en: Remove the duplicate year readout, give timeline markers more room, reduce unused spacing, and improve year jumps and keyboard feedback.

zh: 地图来源信息在页面底部透明居中常驻显示，无需展开，并移除移动端重复年份状态条。
en: Keep map credits permanently visible and centered without a background or expandable popup, and remove the redundant mobile year status.

zh: 修复远距离地点连线越出地图顶部的问题，改善跨日界线连接及选中条目的完整取景。
en: Keep long-distance connections within the map and improve date-line connections and framing of selected entries.

zh: 新增 17 件日常之物，包括可口可乐、番茄酱、奥利奥、眼镜、电饭煲、电热水壶和拉杆箱，并补充来源与图片。
en: Add 17 everyday objects, including Coca-Cola, ketchup, Oreo, eyeglasses, the rice cooker, electric kettle, and rolling suitcase, with sources and images.

zh: 右侧改为按时间浏览的完整目录，搜索、总数和争议开关集中在面板内；打开详情时隐藏目录，关闭后回到原位置。
en: Browse the full collection chronologically in the side panel, with search, totals, and dispute controls there; hide the directory while details are open and restore it on close.

zh: 目录可从边缘收起，详情标题随面板宽度缩放，时间轴与条目面板底部对齐，并简化容器边框。
en: Collapse the directory from its edge, scale detail titles with the panel, align the timeline with the panel, and simplify container borders.

zh: 新增 9 件日常之物，包括空调、铝箔纸、自行车、电风扇、电熨斗、冰箱、垃圾袋、吸尘器和洗衣机，并补充考证来源与图片。
en: Add 9 everyday objects, including the air conditioner, aluminum foil, bicycle, electric fan, electric iron, refrigerator, trash bag, vacuum cleaner, and washing machine, with sourced histories and images.

zh: 引入 20 项主题标签分类并覆盖全部条目，支持单行横向平滑滑动筛选与边界渐变指示。
en: Introduce 20 topic tags across all entries, with a single-line horizontally scrollable filter strip and edge fade indicators.

zh: 条目面板新增原生分享与链接复制功能，底部优化图片来源排版，并改进中英文语言切换字体显示。
en: Add native sharing and link copying to entry details, refine photo source styling, and improve typography across language switches.

zh: 优化首屏展开动画与预渲染过渡体验，无缝衔接地图与目录内容呈现。
en: Refine the initial loading animation and prerendered transition for a smoother atlas reveal.

zh: 时间轴默认展示全部年代；查看条目不再改变探索年份。新增按年代探索，较晚条目弱化显示且仍可点击，并收紧时间轴切换与状态布局。
en: Show all ages by default and keep the explored year unchanged when opening entries. Explore by year with later objects faded but still clickable, using compact timeline controls and status text.

zh: 地图首次加载显示等待提示，后续瓦片加载使用角落提示；加载失败或超时可重试，目录仍可继续使用。
en: Show initial map loading feedback and a compact indicator for later tile loads. Retry failed or timed-out loads while keeping the catalogue usable.

zh: 新增首次访问导览，桌面三步、手机两步，介绍地图与目录操作及桌面时间轴；支持跳过、Esc退出，并可通过顶部问号重新打开。
en: Add a first-visit guide with three desktop steps and two mobile steps covering the map, catalogue, and desktop timeline. Skip or exit with Esc, and reopen it from the header help button.

zh: 新增镜子、梳子、扫帚、勺子、蜡烛和抽水马桶，条目总数增至131项，补齐中英文资料、来源与配图，时间轴延伸至约公元前6000年。
en: Add the mirror, comb, broom, spoon, candle, and flush toilet, bringing the collection to 131 entries with bilingual histories, sources, and images. Extend the timeline to around 6000 BCE.

zh: 时间轴改为中央固定指针与横向标尺，支持拖动、滚轮、键盘和回到现代；选择条目时同步定位其年份。
en: Explore time with a centered cursor and a horizontal ruler using dragging, scrolling, keyboard controls, and a return-to-present button. Selecting an entry moves the ruler to its year.

zh: 地图按当前年份区分已出现与较晚条目，减弱背景光晕；新出现的条目短暂点亮，选中条目轻微呼吸，并适配减少动态效果设置。
en: Distinguish earlier and later entries on the map with softer background halos. Newly activated entries briefly light up, selected entries gently breathe, and reduced-motion preferences are respected.

zh: 详情底部新增上一条、下一条导航卡片，支持键盘翻阅条目，并调整详情标题、返回按钮及操作区布局。
en: Browse entries with previous and next navigation cards and keyboard controls, with refined detail headings, back buttons, and action layouts.

zh: 移动端面板按钮增加展开、收起文字和条目数量提示，收起后以底部按钮继续访问目录。
en: Mobile panel controls show expand and collapse labels and entry counts, with a bottom button to reopen the catalogue.

zh: 改善中英文页面首次加载及分享信息，新增包含随机条目推荐的404页面，可返回主页或继续探索条目。
en: Improve initial loading and sharing metadata for Chinese and English pages. Add a 404 page with a random entry suggestion and links back to the atlas.

zh: 点击标题旁的版本号即可查看更新记录，按版本切换历史内容；页面不再自动检测新版或弹出刷新提示。
en: Open the release history from the version beside the title and switch versions with tabs. The page no longer checks for updates or shows a refresh prompt.

zh: 选中有地点连线的条目时，光点按年份从较早地点流向较晚地点；同年或年份不明的连线保持静止，并遵循减少动态效果设置。
en: When an entry has place connections, a pulse travels from the earlier place to the later one. Connections with the same or unknown year stay still, and reduced-motion preferences are respected.

zh: 条目详情的争议标记只保留图标，避免在分类行里换行。
en: Show only the dispute icon in entry details so the category line no longer wraps.

zh: 修复时间轴年份刻度挤在标尺上方、文字重叠的问题，年份重新显示在刻度下方。
en: Fix timeline year labels crowding above the ruler and overlapping, placing them back beneath the ticks.

zh: 明确范式革命独立品类收录原则；将折叠伞升级为「伞」补齐古代源头，拉杆箱升级为「行李箱」，平底锅重构两河流域与爱琴海古代起点，并新增经典「手表」与「智能手表」独立并存。
en: Establish category inclusion principles for independent paradigm-shifting objects. Upgrade to the overarching umbrella and suitcase, reconstruct the ancient origins of the frying pan, and document the classic wristwatch alongside the smartwatch.

zh: 新增双肩背包、防晒霜、卫生巾、牙线、气泡膜、猫砂、电源插头与插座、烤面包机、T 恤、罐头、菜刀、美工刀、卷笔刀和马克笔，全站独立品类条目增至 143 项。
en: Add 14 paradigm-defining objects including the backpack, sunscreen, sanitary napkin, dental floss, bubble wrap, cat litter, power plug and socket, toaster, T-shirt, tin can, kitchen knife, utility knife, pencil sharpener, and marker pen, expanding the atlas to 143 entries.

zh: 全面校订条目中英文历史考证与术语翻译，修正卫生巾专利归属与防晒霜早期化学防晒史，优化螺旋开瓶器等中文命名，并重构中文字体子集。
en: Thoroughly review bilingual historical records and terminology, correcting patent attributions for sanitary pads and early chemical sunscreen origins, standardizing object names, and rebuilding font subsets.
